rules: Partition the four whole measured documents exhaustively into disjoint owners, including front matter, connective prose, references, unused common results and excluded historical assertions.
Each selected codepoint has exactly one owner; the same physical passage may be included in several node interfaces but is paid once in their union. Repeated printed statements are separately paid.

Use the fixed accepted PDF extraction, furniture and glyph policy. No new calibration or source boundary is permitted. Tokens and normalized collapsed runs belong to the owner of their first character; whole normalization must equal concatenated normalized pieces.

Source and replacement logical closures use only the independently accepted prerequisite edge kinds. Attribution, comparison, validation, formal and operational edges do not add mathematical premises.

Each substantive branch includes its necessary full statement, definitions, presentation and shared setup, even when a historical graph node groups a broader proof. Cost-interface sharing is explicit; it does not modify the logical graph.
All six required mathematical programs remain complete, once each, in the full appendix. Raw files are an alternative representation, not an extra charge. Their internal diagnostics are not removed.

The two drivers, one diagnostic and three Lean files with nine declarations are complete separately measured evidence, not silently folded into mathematical proof routes or treated as end-to-end formal verification.

Expanded retained proofs, unavailable historical programs, catalogue construction, unextracted graphics and intrinsic minimum proof costs remain null. A measured retained statement is not its external proof.

The full common paper is charged independently for this topic, regardless of overlapping earlier topics. Full-document accepted factors are copied unchanged; no theorem-row factors and no node-count factor are computed.
A reading-order acquisition graph is not research chronology or evidence of a sawtooth pattern. Actual reuse requires a bound theorem and a real proof-use edge, with local adapter cost.

roles.prior_role: Reviewed the logical graph, and authored the canonical affine scientific edition. Its mathematics has a distinct root acceptance. This cost assignment requires a different independent reviewer.
